comment: Guardian watcher config. Copy to ~/.aoa-watcher/config.json on the Mini and fill the <...> values (public data only). No secret goes here: the RPC URLs come from the Keychain through run-watcher.sh, the sink tokens and the keystore password from the Keychain through lib/sinks-config.mjs.
aggregator: <BLSAggregator address from the step-13 manifest (= phase-d.json contracts.aggregator)>

roles.superPaymaster: <SuperPaymaster proxy address from the step-13 manifest>

forwarders.dvtValidator: <DVTValidator address from the step-13 manifest (= phase-d.json contracts.dvtValidator)>
forwarders.ownerSafe: <owner Safe address from the step-13 manifest>

secondProvider: <the second RPC's provider name, e.g. tenderly (a label, never a URL)>

registry.maxFeePerGas: <absolute ceiling in wei, e.g. 200000000000 for 200 gwei>
